# MoodFlow

MoodFlow is an iOS mood journal built on Paul Ekman’s basic emotions (埃克曼六种基本情绪 / six basic emotions). Colors in the app map to the model, and Settings includes an Ekman explainer.

- Page: https://yetaimei.github.io/moodflow-site/basic-emotions/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/moodflow-mood-tracker-journal/id6755678705?ppid=54b1b9c3-e3b8-4543-8ce9-d850d7b2e02f
- Home: https://yetaimei.github.io/moodflow-site/
